h: The Spies and Faith Beyond the Measure of Merit

p: "they were heads of the Children of Yisrael."
And in the Midrash Rabbah (on this parshah, Bamidbar Rabbah 16:5):
children in whom there is no faith'
for they were chosen out of all Yisrael
מִפִּי הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא וּמִפִּי מֹשֶׁה
by the word of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and by the word of Moshe,
as it is written, 'And it was good…' (Devarim 1:23);
from here, that they were tzaddikim
in the eyes of Yisrael and in the eyes of Moshe…";
and He told him they were worthy.
"and afterward, at the end of forty days,
they turned around…" and so on.
Now this needs to be understood:
in the eyes of Yisrael and in the eyes of Moshe,
and of whom HaKadosh Baruch Hu said
how could they spread an evil report
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 158a):
"If Yisrael go up to the land,
we will be removed from being heads,
and Moshe will appoint other heads…" and so on;
"but in the land we will not merit…" and so on.
Now this needs to be understood:
would lie because of such a personal interest,
that in Eretz Yisrael they would not be heads?
that they were in the wilderness,
eating the manna and drinking the waters of the well,
so that the words of Torah would be absorbed
וְכֵן הוּא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (בְּשַׁלַּח, חֵלֶק ב סב, ב)
and so it is in the holy Zohar (Beshalach, Zohar II 62b):
"And then it is blessed in the innards…" and so on,
they are called the Generation of Knowledge," and so on
וְעִם כָּל זֶה כְּתִיב (דְּבָרִים ט, ה)
or the uprightness of your heart
do you come to possess their land,
but because of the wickedness of the nations…
and in order to fulfill the word…"
who knew that they were heads of the Children of Yisrael,
when they came to Eretz Yisrael
that by their own righteousness they were not worthy
from this they reasoned a fortiori
that they were certainly not worthy.
And the wickedness of the nations, too
עֲדַיִין לֹא שָׁלֵם עֲוֹן הָאֱמוֹרִי (בְּרֵאשִׁית טו, טז)
"the iniquity of the Emori was not yet complete" (Bereishis 15:16),
their measure had not yet been filled.
Therefore, according to this reasoning of theirs,
they said that it was impossible
"children in whom there is no faith";
"And they have tested Me these ten times";
and this was the tenth test.
corresponds to the ten holy attributes;
against the attribute of Keser Elyon,
which is the crown of kingship:
"Who tells from the beginning the end" (Yeshayahu 46:10).
And it is the aspect of
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (יִתְרוֹ, חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Yisro, Zohar II 88a):
and this is the entire central line,
And regarding Avraham it is written (Bereishis 15:6):
and He counted it to him as righteousness";
Hashem Yisbarach counted to him as righteousness,
"and He counted it to him as merit."
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, asked:
What merit is it for a prophet
what he heard explicitly from Hashem Yisbarach?
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (מְגִילָּה טז, א)
"It is likened to the stars…" and so on;
they rise up to the stars."
to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him (Bereishis 15:5):
That is, that they would be men
like the stars of the heavens.
that in this world there is free choice;
so how can this promise be,
when the choice is in the hand of man?
מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הָרַמְבַּ״ם זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בָּזֶה
what the Rambam, of blessed memory, wrote on this
and how the Raavad, of blessed memory, objected;
and like the words of the Rambam
it is explicit in the Zohar Chadash
and in the Arizal, of blessed memory,
that there is a place where there is no free choice,
namely in the attribute of Atika Kadisha,
above human grasp and our intellect,
and it is hidden from all thought.
And about this it says, "And he believed in Hashem":
that they will be like the stars of the heavens
even though there is free choice.
And this is called complete faith,
"and He counted it to him as righteousness":
that this faith He counted to him as righteousness.
And so it is expounded (Shemos Rabbah 23:5):
תָּשׁוּרִי מֵרֹאשׁ אֲמָנָה (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ד, ח)
"'Look from the peak of Amanah' (Shir HaShirim 4:8):
with which Avraham believed in HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
Yisrael merited to say song," and so on.
And this is called "the peak of Amanah,"
וְכֵן גַּם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּתִיב (שְׁמוֹת יד, לא)
And likewise regarding Yisrael it is written (Shemos 14:31):
and those are…" and so on,
nevertheless it was within the power
to raise them to the level
where "a maidservant saw at the Sea
what the prophets did not see,"
as is written in the holy Zohar,
that the splitting of the Sea
that they would enter Eretz Yisrael,
that even they were not worthy
to inherit through their own righteousness.
for in truth it is written (Bamidbar 10:33):
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem journeyed before them
to seek out a resting place for them";
through the power of the Torah,
which is "the Ark of the covenant of Hashem,"
in the holiness of the three Avos,
who stand against the three kelipos,
"to seek out a resting place for them":
that they would enter Eretz Yisrael,
and that they would be refined completely
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכָלֵב (בְּמִדְבַּר יד, ח)
And about this Yehoshua and Kalev said (Bamidbar 14:8):
wants nothing from us but the heart,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קס, א)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 160a).
That is, Hashem Yisbarach is able
to put all the holinesses into the heart,
so as "to seek out a resting place for them,"
as it was at the splitting of the Sea,
where "a maidservant saw at the Sea," and so on,
although there had been an accusation against them beforehand.
שֶׁהָיָה חָסֵר לָהֶם אֱמוּנָה שְׁלֵימָה זוֹ
therefore, since they sensed in themselves
to inherit through their own righteousness,
and if they were able to enter
and the deficiency was only in themselves,
then certainly Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
so that they would not be heads;
And in truth, after they had gone astray then,
but because of the wickedness of the nations…
that is, in the merit of the Avos.
And he recalled to them then
that is, they had not repaired
the holiness of the three Avos,
as we have said several times;
"to seek out a resting place for them."
"And were Yisrael to keep…" and so on,
אַךְ הָעוֹלָם נִידּוֹן אַחַר רוּבּוֹ (קִידּוּשִׁין מ, ב)
but the world is judged by its majority (Kiddushin 40b).
